description: Boolean on closed objects, by id (elements or other objects): union (merge), subtract (the first minus the others, which are removed), trim (the same, the others kept) or intersect (only the overlap). The first id is kept and becomes a plain mesh (it loses parametric data, so walls, slabs, roofs, stairs and columns can only cut, not be cut). A door or window used to cut cuts its rough opening and stays, e.g. to open an imported wall. Objects that aren't closed solids are refused. Returns the result's id.
name: solid_operation
title: Solid tools (booleans)
